library ieee;
  use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
  use ieee.numeric_std.all;

-- Board adapter for the exact Aurora configuration generated by
-- scripts/ip/create_aurora_duplex_sfp0.tcl.  The companion verification Tcl
-- compares the generated .vho against every vendor port used below before a
-- project is allowed to build.
entity obsidian_aurora_duplex_adapter is
  port (
    gt_refclk_p_i     : in  std_logic;
    gt_refclk_n_i     : in  std_logic;
    system_reset_i    : in  std_logic;
    fabric_init_clk_i : in  std_logic;
    init_clk_o        : out std_logic;

    sfp0_txp_o : out std_logic;
    sfp0_txn_o : out std_logic;
    sfp0_rxp_i : in  std_logic;
    sfp0_rxn_i : in  std_logic;

    user_clk_o : out std_logic;

    s_axi_tx_tdata_i  : in  std_logic_vector(15 downto 0);
    s_axi_tx_tkeep_i  : in  std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
    s_axi_tx_tvalid_i : in  std_logic;
    s_axi_tx_tready_o : out std_logic;
    s_axi_tx_tlast_i  : in  std_logic;

    m_axi_rx_tdata_o  : out std_logic_vector(15 downto 0);
    m_axi_rx_tkeep_o  : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
    m_axi_rx_tvalid_o : out std_logic;
    m_axi_rx_tlast_o  : out std_logic;

    lane_up_o           : out std_logic;
    channel_up_o        : out std_logic;
    hard_err_o          : out std_logic;
    soft_err_o          : out std_logic;
    frame_err_o         : out std_logic;
    tx_reset_done_o     : out std_logic;
    rx_reset_done_o     : out std_logic;
    common_pll_lock_o   : out std_logic;
    rx_byte_aligned_o   : out std_logic;
    rx_pma_reset_done_o : out std_logic
  );
end entity obsidian_aurora_duplex_adapter;

architecture rtl of obsidian_aurora_duplex_adapter is
  -- Keep the generated stub as the sole owner of black-box metadata.  In
  -- particular, do not override black_box_pad_pin or force IO_BUFFER_TYPE on
  -- the four serial signals: Vivado needs the normal top I/O markers before
  -- read_checkpoint -cell retargets the boundary to GTPE2_CHANNEL.
  -- This is the SupportLevel=1, one-lane, 16-bit framing interface emitted by
  -- Aurora 8B/10B 11.1 in Vivado 2025.2 with TransceiverControl enabled.
  component aurora_duplex_sfp0 is
    port (
      s_axi_tx_tdata  : in  std_logic_vector(0 to 15);
      s_axi_tx_tkeep  : in  std_logic_vector(0 to 1);
      s_axi_tx_tlast  : in  std_logic;
      s_axi_tx_tvalid : in  std_logic;
      s_axi_tx_tready : out std_logic;
      m_axi_rx_tdata  : out std_logic_vector(0 to 15);
      m_axi_rx_tkeep  : out std_logic_vector(0 to 1);
      m_axi_rx_tlast  : out std_logic;
      m_axi_rx_tvalid : out std_logic;
      hard_err        : out std_logic;
      soft_err        : out std_logic;
      frame_err       : out std_logic;
      channel_up      : out std_logic;
      lane_up         : out std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);
      txp             : out std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);
      txn             : out std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);
      reset           : in  std_logic;
      gt_reset        : in  std_logic;
      loopback        : in  std_logic_vector(2 downto 0);
      rxp             : in  std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);
      rxn             : in  std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);
      drpclk_in       : in  std_logic;
      drpaddr_in      : in  std_logic_vector(8 downto 0);
      drpen_in        : in  std_logic;
      drpdi_in        : in  std_logic_vector(15 downto 0);
      drprdy_out      : out std_logic;
      drpdo_out       : out std_logic_vector(15 downto 0);
      drpwe_in        : in  std_logic;
      power_down      : in  std_logic;
      tx_lock         : out std_logic;
      tx_resetdone_out: out std_logic;
      rx_resetdone_out: out std_logic;
      link_reset_out  : out std_logic;
      init_clk_in     : in  std_logic;
      user_clk_out    : out std_logic;
      pll_not_locked_out : out std_logic;
      sys_reset_out      : out std_logic;
      gt_refclk1_p       : in  std_logic;
      gt_refclk1_n       : in  std_logic;
      sync_clk_out       : out std_logic;
      gt_reset_out       : out std_logic;
      gt_refclk1_out     : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll0refclklost_out : out std_logic;
      quad1_common_lock_out  : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll0outclk_out     : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll1outclk_out     : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll0outrefclk_out  : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll1outrefclk_out  : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll0lock_out       : out std_logic;
      gt0_pll1lock_out       : out std_logic;
      gt0_tx_buf_err_out     : out std_logic;
      gt0_txpolarity_in      : in  std_logic;
      gt0_txchardispmode_in  : in  std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
      gt0_txchardispval_in   : in  std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
      gt0_txpostcursor_in    : in  std_logic_vector(4 downto 0);
      gt0_txprecursor_in     : in  std_logic_vector(4 downto 0);
      gt0_txdiffctrl_in      : in  std_logic_vector(3 downto 0);
      gt0_txmaincursor_in    : in  std_logic_vector(6 downto 0);
      gt0_txprbsforceerr_in  : in  std_logic;
      gt0_txprbssel_in       : in  std_logic_vector(2 downto 0);
      gt0_txpcsreset_in      : in  std_logic;
      gt0_txpmareset_in      : in  std_logic;
      gt0_txinhibit_in       : in  std_logic;
      gt0_txresetdone_out    : out std_logic;
      gt0_txbufstatus_out    : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
      gt0_rxlpmhfhold_in        : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxlpmlfhold_in        : in  std_logic;
      gt0_eyescanreset_in       : in  std_logic;
      gt0_eyescandataerror_out  : out std_logic;
      gt0_rxbyteisaligned_out   : out std_logic;
      gt0_rxcommadet_out        : out std_logic;
      gt0_rx_realign_out        : out std_logic;
      gt0_rx_buf_err_out        : out std_logic;
      gt0_rx_disp_err_out       : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
      gt0_rx_not_in_table_out   : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0);
      gt0_eyescantrigger_in     : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxresetdone_out       : out std_logic;
      gt0_rxlpmhfovrden_in      : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxlpmreset_in         : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxcdrhold_in          : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxprbserr_out         : out std_logic;
      gt0_rxprbssel_in          : in  std_logic_vector(2 downto 0);
      gt0_rxprbscntreset_in     : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxpcsreset_in         : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxpmareset_in         : in  std_logic;
      gt0_rxbufreset_in         : in  std_logic;
      gt0_dmonitorout_out       : out std_logic_vector(14 downto 0);
      gt0_rxbufstatus_out       : out std_logic_vector(2 downto 0);
      gt0_rxpmaresetdone_out    : out std_logic
    );
  end component;

  signal tx_tdata_asc : std_logic_vector(0 to 15);
  signal tx_tkeep_asc : std_logic_vector(0 to 1);
  signal rx_tdata_asc : std_logic_vector(0 to 15);
  signal rx_tkeep_asc : std_logic_vector(0 to 1);
  signal lane_up_vec  : std_logic_vector(0 downto 0);

  signal user_clk          : std_logic;
  signal gt_reset_core     : std_logic := '1';
  signal release_user_reset: std_logic := '0';
  signal user_reset_pipe   : std_logic_vector(1 downto 0) := (others => '1');
  signal aurora_reset      : std_logic := '1';
  signal reset_counter     : unsigned(6 downto 0) := (others => '0');
  signal pll_not_locked    : std_logic;
  signal quad_common_lock  : std_logic;
  signal pll0_lock         : std_logic;
  signal tx_reset_done     : std_logic;
  signal rx_reset_done     : std_logic;
  signal rx_byte_aligned   : std_logic;
  signal rx_pma_reset_done : std_logic;
  signal drprdy_unused     : std_logic;
  signal drpdo_unused      : std_logic_vector(15 downto 0);

  attribute ASYNC_REG : string;
  attribute ASYNC_REG of user_reset_pipe : signal is "TRUE";
  attribute SHREG_EXTRACT : string;
  attribute SHREG_EXTRACT of user_reset_pipe : signal is "NO";
begin
  init_clk_o <= fabric_init_clk_i;
  user_clk_o <= user_clk;

  tx_tdata_asc      <= s_axi_tx_tdata_i;
  tx_tkeep_asc      <= s_axi_tx_tkeep_i;
  m_axi_rx_tdata_o  <= rx_tdata_asc;
  m_axi_rx_tkeep_o  <= rx_tkeep_asc;

  lane_up_o           <= lane_up_vec(0);
  tx_reset_done_o     <= tx_reset_done;
  rx_reset_done_o     <= rx_reset_done;
  common_pll_lock_o   <= quad_common_lock and pll0_lock and not pll_not_locked;
  rx_byte_aligned_o   <= rx_byte_aligned;
  rx_pma_reset_done_o <= rx_pma_reset_done;

  -- GT reset is held for 32 cycles of the clean 50 MHz fabric init clock.
  -- The Aurora protocol reset is then released synchronously to USER_CLK.
  p_gt_startup : process (fabric_init_clk_i, system_reset_i)
  begin
    if system_reset_i = '1' then
      reset_counter      <= (others => '0');
      gt_reset_core      <= '1';
      release_user_reset <= '0';
    elsif rising_edge(fabric_init_clk_i) then
        if reset_counter /= to_unsigned(127, reset_counter'length) then
          reset_counter <= reset_counter + 1;
        end if;
        if reset_counter >= to_unsigned(31, reset_counter'length) then
          gt_reset_core <= '0';
        end if;
        if reset_counter >= to_unsigned(47, reset_counter'length) then
          release_user_reset <= '1';
        end if;
    end if;
  end process p_gt_startup;

  p_user_reset : process (user_clk, release_user_reset)
  begin
    if release_user_reset = '0' then
      user_reset_pipe <= (others => '1');
    elsif rising_edge(user_clk) then
      user_reset_pipe(0) <= '0';
      user_reset_pipe(1) <= user_reset_pipe(0);
    end if;
  end process p_user_reset;

  -- Present a strictly synchronous reset to the Aurora core.  This ordinary
  -- boundary register also prevents Vivado from merging the adapter's CDC
  -- synchronizer conceptually with the frozen core's internal reset pipe.
  p_aurora_reset : process (user_clk)
  begin
    if rising_edge(user_clk) then
      aurora_reset <= user_reset_pipe(1);
    end if;
  end process p_aurora_reset;

  u_aurora : aurora_duplex_sfp0
    port map (
      s_axi_tx_tdata         => tx_tdata_asc,
      s_axi_tx_tkeep         => tx_tkeep_asc,
      s_axi_tx_tlast         => s_axi_tx_tlast_i,
      s_axi_tx_tvalid        => s_axi_tx_tvalid_i,
      s_axi_tx_tready        => s_axi_tx_tready_o,
      m_axi_rx_tdata         => rx_tdata_asc,
      m_axi_rx_tkeep         => rx_tkeep_asc,
      m_axi_rx_tlast         => m_axi_rx_tlast_o,
      m_axi_rx_tvalid        => m_axi_rx_tvalid_o,
      hard_err               => hard_err_o,
      soft_err               => soft_err_o,
      frame_err              => frame_err_o,
      channel_up             => channel_up_o,
      lane_up                => lane_up_vec,
      txp(0)                 => sfp0_txp_o,
      txn(0)                 => sfp0_txn_o,
      reset                  => aurora_reset,
      gt_reset               => gt_reset_core,
      loopback               => "000",
      rxp(0)                 => sfp0_rxp_i,
      rxn(0)                 => sfp0_rxn_i,
      drpclk_in              => fabric_init_clk_i,
      drpaddr_in             => (others => '0'),
      drpen_in               => '0',
      drpdi_in               => (others => '0'),
      drprdy_out             => drprdy_unused,
      drpdo_out              => drpdo_unused,
      drpwe_in               => '0',
      power_down             => '0',
      tx_lock                => open,
      tx_resetdone_out       => tx_reset_done,
      rx_resetdone_out       => rx_reset_done,
      link_reset_out         => open,
      init_clk_in            => fabric_init_clk_i,
      user_clk_out           => user_clk,
      pll_not_locked_out     => pll_not_locked,
      sys_reset_out          => open,
      gt_refclk1_p           => gt_refclk_p_i,
      gt_refclk1_n           => gt_refclk_n_i,
      sync_clk_out           => open,
      gt_reset_out           => open,
      gt_refclk1_out         => open,
      gt0_pll0refclklost_out => open,
      quad1_common_lock_out  => quad_common_lock,
      gt0_pll0outclk_out     => open,
      gt0_pll1outclk_out     => open,
      gt0_pll0outrefclk_out  => open,
      gt0_pll1outrefclk_out  => open,
      gt0_pll0lock_out       => pll0_lock,
      gt0_pll1lock_out       => open,
      gt0_tx_buf_err_out     => open,
      gt0_txpolarity_in      => '0',
      gt0_txchardispmode_in  => "00",
      gt0_txchardispval_in   => "00",
      gt0_txpostcursor_in    => "00000",
      gt0_txprecursor_in     => "00000",
      gt0_txdiffctrl_in      => "1000",
      gt0_txmaincursor_in    => "0000000",
      gt0_txprbsforceerr_in  => '0',
      gt0_txprbssel_in       => "000",
      gt0_txpcsreset_in      => '0',
      gt0_txpmareset_in      => '0',
      gt0_txinhibit_in       => '0',
      gt0_txresetdone_out    => open,
      gt0_txbufstatus_out    => open,
      gt0_rxlpmhfhold_in       => '0',
      gt0_rxlpmlfhold_in       => '0',
      gt0_eyescanreset_in      => '0',
      gt0_eyescandataerror_out => open,
      gt0_rxbyteisaligned_out  => rx_byte_aligned,
      gt0_rxcommadet_out       => open,
      gt0_rx_realign_out       => open,
      gt0_rx_buf_err_out       => open,
      gt0_rx_disp_err_out      => open,
      gt0_rx_not_in_table_out  => open,
      gt0_eyescantrigger_in    => '0',
      gt0_rxresetdone_out      => open,
      gt0_rxlpmhfovrden_in     => '0',
      gt0_rxlpmreset_in        => '0',
      gt0_rxcdrhold_in         => '0',
      gt0_rxprbserr_out        => open,
      gt0_rxprbssel_in         => "000",
      gt0_rxprbscntreset_in    => '0',
      gt0_rxpcsreset_in        => '0',
      gt0_rxpmareset_in        => '0',
      gt0_rxbufreset_in        => '0',
      gt0_dmonitorout_out      => open,
      gt0_rxbufstatus_out      => open,
      gt0_rxpmaresetdone_out   => rx_pma_reset_done
    );
end architecture rtl;
